description: This file contains the base views and utility functions for the Superset web application, including template rendering, bootstrap data generation, theme management, response customization, and common API decorators.

classes.name: BaseSupersetView
classes.description: Base view class providing JSON response and template rendering utilities for Superset.

classes.name: SupersetModelView
classes.description: ModelView subclass for rendering the main SPA template with context.

classes.name: DeleteMixin
classes.description: Mixin providing delete functionality for views, including bulk delete actions.

classes.name: DatasourceFilter
classes.description: Custom filter for data source access control based on user permissions.

classes.name: CsvResponse
classes.description: Response class for CSV exports with configurable encoding.

methods.name: get_error_msg
methods.description: Returns error message string, including stack trace if enabled.

methods.name: json_success
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with given message and status.

methods.name: data_payload_response
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with payload, status 400 if error.

methods.name: generate_download_headers
methods.description: Generates headers for file download with filename and extension.

methods.name: deprecated
methods.description: Decorator to mark API endpoints as deprecated with warning logs.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Decorator to catch exceptions and return JSON error responses.

methods.name: json_response
methods.description: Serializes an object to JSON response.

methods.name: render_app_template
methods.description: Renders the main SPA template with context.

methods.name: get_environment_tag
methods.description: Returns environment tag info based on config and environment variable.

methods.name: menu_data
methods.description: Generates menu and branding data for the frontend.

methods.name: _merge_theme_dicts
methods.description: Recursively merges two theme dictionaries.

methods.name: _load_theme_from_model
methods.description: Loads and parses theme JSON from database model, merging with fallback.

methods.name: _process_theme
methods.description: Validates and processes theme data, returning empty dict if invalid.

methods.name: get_theme_bootstrap_data
methods.description: Returns theme data (default and dark) for frontend, from config or database.

methods.name: get_default_spinner_svg
methods.description: Loads and caches default spinner SVG content from assets.

methods.name: cached_common_bootstrap_data
methods.description: Memoized function returning common bootstrap data for client.

methods.name: common_bootstrap_payload
methods.description: Returns bootstrap data for current user and locale.

methods.name: get_spa_payload
methods.description: Generates payload for spa.html including user, bootstrap, theme, and extras.

methods.name: get_spa_template_context
methods.description: Generates context for spa.html template, including theme and spinner logic.

methods.name: render_app_template
methods.description: Renders the main SPA template with context.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a record by primary key, with pre- and post-delete hooks.

methods.name: muldelete
methods.description: Bulk delete action for multiple records.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies data source access filter based on user permissions.

methods.name: __bind_field
methods.description: Customizes WTForms field binding to strip whitespace.
